text: Undated scanned note. Eosinophils 1.90 x10^9/L. Prednisone 50 mg daily for 5 days for asthma exacerbation.
Respirology consult. Impression: severe allergic asthma. Spirometry with significant bronchodilator reversibility. Patient is a lifelong non-smoker; husband smokes outside.
Asthma flare after a cold. Prednisone 50 mg once daily x 5 days. Meds: budesonide/formoterol 200/6 mcg two inhalations twice daily, salbutamol 100 mcg two puffs as needed.
Respirology follow-up. Diagnosis: severe allergic asthma, confirmed on review of spirometry and clinical course. Plan: apply for mepolizumab coverage.
Mepolizumab commenced 2025-01-15 via respirology. Tolerating well so far.
Telephone follow-up. Query vocal cord dysfunction contributing; asthma diagnosis to be reviewed at next visit.
Mepolizumab discontinued 2025-09-01 because of inadequate response after eight months. Smoking cessation resources discussed with husband.
Acute asthma exacerbation. Dexamethasone 12 mg given orally in department. Discharged with prednisone 50 mg daily for 5 days.
Follow-up after ED visit. Completed prednisone course. Asthma improving. Current inhalers: budesonide/formoterol 200/6 mcg two inhalations twice daily; salbutamol 100 mcg two puffs as needed.
Shingles, left T4 dermatome. Valacyclovir started. Prednisone 40 mg daily for 7 days for pain. Asthma well controlled today.
Presented with wheeze and shortness of breath; asthma exacerbation. Nebulised salbutamol and ipratropium x3. Methylprednisolone 125 mg IV given. Discharged on prednisone 50 mg daily for 5 days.
Discharge summary. Admitted 2026-03-05 with asthma exacerbation; treated with IV methylprednisolone then oral prednisone, course to finish 2026-03-10.

Asthma exacerbation with viral URTI. Patient declined prednisone; managed with increased reliever use. Switched budesonide/formoterol to fluticasone furoate/vilanterol 200/25 mcg one inhalation once daily.
CBC with differential. Specimen collected 2026-07-17. WBC 7.2 x10^9/L. Eosinophils 6.1 %. Absolute eosinophils 0.44 x10^9/L.
Sputum eosinophils 4% on induced sputum. Blood eosinophils pending.
Addendum to report of 2026-07-19: corrected comment only; result unchanged. Specimen collected 2026-07-17. Eosinophils 0.44 x10^9/L.

Dispensed: fluticasone furoate/vilanterol 200/25 mcg one inhalation once daily; salbutamol 100 mcg two puffs as needed; fluticasone propionate nasal spray 50 mcg two sprays each nostril daily; montelukast 10 mg at bedtime; prednisone 5 mg tablets (rescue supply).

Patient reports she has resumed smoking, about 5 cigarettes a day since the summer. Counselled. Re-referred to respirology regarding Drug Z. Pharmacy fax lists PHN SYNTH-PHN-0024 and DOB 1975-02-11, which belong to a different patient.
Seen today. Diagnosis of severe allergic asthma confirmed. Blood eosinophils 0.80 x10^9/L on 2026-11-18. Prednisone 50 mg daily for 5 days for asthma exacerbation.
